description_en: Disables log delivery for an integrated cloud service. After the delivery is disabled, no new logs are written to the user's Logstore
description_zh: 关闭某个已经接入的云产品日志的投递，关闭后用户侧的LogStore里不再有对应日志的新内容
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem close-delivery --product-code sas --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:
0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose perspective the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select the region of the management center based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Select this value if your assets are located in the Chinese mainland and Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Select this value if your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项
parameters.name: region_id

Data.description_en:
The result of disabling the service in Threat Analysis. Valid values:
true: The service is disabled.
false: The service fails to be disabled
Data.description_zh:
威胁分析关闭服务的返回。取值：
true：关闭成功
false：关闭失败
